title: Best Hay For Rabbits
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Best Hay For Rabbits
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage and bedding guide.
-->

<section class="rch-page alignfull" id="best-hay-for-rabbits">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rch-page,
    .rch-page * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main {
      background: #fef4f0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image {
      display: none !important;
    }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * {
      margin-block-start: 0 !important;
    }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rch-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rch-page a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .rch-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rch-wrap {
      width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rch-narrow {
      width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .rch-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rch-pill::before {
      content: "✦";
      color: var(--rc-gold);
    }

    .rch-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rch-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rch-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .rch-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rch-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rch-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rch-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rch-hero-cover {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rch-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rch-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rchFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rch-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rch-hero-title-overlay .rch-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rch-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rch-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rch-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rch-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rch-breadcrumb a {
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
    }

    .rch-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rch-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rch-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rch-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rch-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rch-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rch-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rch-quickbar {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 4;
      margin-top: 26px;
    }

    .rch-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rch-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rch-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rch-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rch-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rch-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rch-section {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .rch-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rch-section h2,
    .rch-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rch-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rch-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rch-content {
      display: grid;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .rch-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rch-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rch-panel > * {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .rch-panel h2 {
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .rch-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rch-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rch-panel p:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .rch-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rch-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rch-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rch-hay-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rch-hay-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 280px;
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rch-hay-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rch-hay-icon {
      display: inline-grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.13);
      font-size: 2rem;
    }

    .rch-hay-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.32rem;
    }

    .rch-hay-card p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rch-mini-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 9px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rch-mini-list li {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      color: #4b453c;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 750;
    }

    .rch-mini-list li::before {
      content: "•";
      color: var(--rc-gold);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rch-cuts {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 18px;
    }

    .rch-cut {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
    }

    .rch-cut strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rch-cut span {
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 650;
      font-size: 0.94rem;
    }

    .rch-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rch-image-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 430px;
    }

    .rch-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rch-image-card img:hover {
      transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important;
    }

    .rch-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rch-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
    }

    .rch-quality {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rch-quality-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rch-quality-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rch-quality-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rch-quality-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: #3f3a33;
      font-weight: 800;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
    }

    .rch-quality-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rch-warning-note {
      margin-top: 18px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
      border: 1px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
    }

    .rch-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rch-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rch-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rch-step h3 {
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.22rem;
    }

    .rch-step p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
    }

    .rch-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rch-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rch-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rch-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rch-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rch-side-card a:hover {
      transform: translateX(4px);
      background: #fff4d8;
    }

    .rch-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rch-note strong {
      color: var(--rc-moss);
    }

    .rch-final {
      padding: 70px 0 42px;
      background: #fef4f0;
    }

    .rch-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-hay-2.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rch-final-box .rch-pill,
    .rch-final-box h2,
    .rch-final-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rch-final-box p {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rch-final-box .rch-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .rch-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rch-related,
    .rch-related * {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rch-related .rch-section-header {
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 34px;

            <div class="rch-hay-icon">🌾</div>
            <h3>Timothy hay</h3>
            <p>
              Timothy hay is one of the most popular and widely recommended types of hay for rabbits. It is high in fibre and relatively low in calcium and protein, making it ideal for adult rabbits.
            </p>
            <div class="rch-cuts">
              <div class="rch-cut"><strong>First cut</strong><span>Coarser, stemmier and often contains more seed heads.</span></div>
              <div class="rch-cut"><strong>Second cut</strong><span>Softer, greener and often preferred by rabbits.</span></div>
              <div class="rch-cut"><strong>Third cut</strong><span>Very soft and leafy, but usually slightly lower in fibre.</span></div>
            </div>
          </article>

          <article class="rch-hay-card">
            <div class="rch-hay-icon">🌿</div>
            <h3>Meadow hay</h3>
            <p>
              Meadow hay is made from a mixture of natural grasses and plants. This variety can be especially appealing because it often includes different textures and flavours that rabbits enjoy.
            </p>
            <ul class="rch-mini-list">
              <li>Variety of grasses</li>
              <li>Natural taste</li>
              <li>Good fibre content</li>
              <li>Feels close to natural grazing</li>
            </ul>
          </article>

          <article class="rch-hay-card">
            <div class="rch-hay-icon">🍃</div>
            <h3>Orchard grass hay</h3>
            <p>
              Orchard grass hay is softer than timothy hay and has a slightly sweet smell. It can be a good alternative for rabbits that are picky eaters or refuse timothy hay.
            </p>
            <ul class="rch-mini-list">
              <li>Soft and leafy</li>
              <li>High in fibre</li>
              <li>Gentle on sensitive noses</li>
              <li>May produce less dust</li>
            </ul>
          </article>

          <article class="rch-hay-card">
            <div class="rch-hay-icon">🌱</div>
            <h3>Alfalfa hay</h3>
            <p>
              Alfalfa hay is different because it is a legume rather than a grass. It contains higher levels of protein and calcium, so it is usually recommended for young rabbits or rabbits needing extra calories.
            </p>
            <ul class="rch-mini-list">
              <li>Best for baby rabbits</li>
              <li>Useful for young rabbits under six months</li>
              <li>Higher in calories</li>
              <li>Usually not ideal as a main adult rabbit hay</li>
            </ul>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div>
          <span class="rch-pill">Fresh hay checklist</span>
          <h2>What high-quality hay looks like</h2>
          <p>
            Not all hay is the same quality. Fresh, high-quality hay should look, smell and feel clean. Avoid hay that looks brown, smells musty or feels overly dusty.
          </p>
          <div class="rch-warning-note">
            Avoid hay that is mouldy, damp, musty-smelling or very dusty.
          </div>
        </div>

        <ul class="rch-quality-list">
          <li>
            <strong>Fresh colour</strong>
            Good hay is usually green or slightly golden, not dull brown.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Pleasant smell</strong>
            Fresh hay should smell grassy, fragrant and clean.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Dry and clean</strong>
            It should be free from mould, dampness and clumps.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Mostly dust-free</strong>
            Some small particles are normal, but hay should not be clouds of dust.
          </li>
        </ul>

    <section class="rch-section rch-reveal" id="how-much">
      <div class="rch-wrap">
        <div class="rch-section-header">
          <span class="rch-pill">Feeding amounts</span>
          <h2>How much hay should rabbits eat?</h2>
          <p>
            Rabbits should have unlimited hay available at all times. A good rule of thumb is that a rabbit should eat a pile of hay roughly the size of their body every day.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rch-steps">
          <article class="rch-step">
            <b>1</b>
            <h3>Offer unlimited hay</h3>
            <p>
              Keep hay topped up throughout the day so your rabbit can graze whenever they want.
            </p>
          </article>

          <article class="rch-step">
            <b>2</b>
            <h3>Refresh it often</h3>
            <p>
              Rabbits are more likely to eat hay that smells fresh and has just been added.
            </p>
          </article>

          <article class="rch-step">
            <b>3</b>
            <h3>Watch daily intake</h3>
            <p>
              A sudden drop in hay eating can be important, especially if your rabbit also seems quiet or stops pooing.
            </p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>

          <h2>Tips for encouraging rabbits to eat more hay</h2>
          <p>
            If your rabbit doesn’t seem interested in hay, there are a few simple things you can try. Small changes in freshness, placement and variety can make a big difference.
          </p>

          <ul class="rch-list">
            <li>Offer different types of hay, such as timothy, meadow or orchard grass.</li>
            <li>Place hay near or inside the litter tray, as many rabbits like to eat while toileting.</li>
            <li>Provide fresh hay multiple times per day to make it more tempting.</li>
            <li>Use hay feeders, racks or boxes to keep hay cleaner and easier to access.</li>
            <li>Mix softer and stalkier textures to discover what your rabbit prefers.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="rch-panel">
          <div class="rch-section-header">
            <span class="rch-pill">Rabbit hay FAQs</span>
            <h2>FAQs about rabbit hay</h2>
            <p>Quick answers to common questions about choosing hay, feeding enough of it and using hay bags safely.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="rch-faq-list">
            <details class="rch-faq-item">
              <summary>What is the best hay for rabbits?</summary>
              <p>Timothy hay, meadow hay and orchard grass hay are all good everyday choices for most adult rabbits. The best hay is fresh, clean, mostly dust-free and something your rabbit will happily eat.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rch-faq-item">
              <summary>Should rabbits have hay all the time?</summary>
              <p>Yes. Rabbits should have unlimited fresh hay available at all times so they can graze throughout the day and night.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rch-faq-item">
              <summary>Are hay bags and hay feeders useful for rabbits?</summary>
              <p>Yes, they can help keep hay accessible, organised and off the floor. Always hang them securely and remove them if your rabbit chews fabric, hooks, straps or loose parts.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rch-faq-item">
              <summary>Can adult rabbits eat alfalfa hay?</summary>
              <p>Alfalfa hay is richer than grass hay, so it is usually better for young rabbits or rabbits needing extra calories rather than as the main hay for most healthy adults.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rch-faq-item">
              <summary>How can I encourage my rabbit to eat more hay?</summary>
              <p>Offer fresh hay several times a day, try different types, place hay near the litter tray and use safe hay feeders or boxes to make hay easy to reach.</p>
            </details>
          </div>
